## Design Context

### Users
Brand marketers, advertising agencies, and creative directors seeking campaign imagery for global brands. Users are typically creative professionals evaluating portfolio work, seeking inspiration, or considering ART.DIRECTED. for campaign production. Context: browsing on desktop in agency/office settings, or on mobile/tablet for reference during meetings.

### Brand Personality
Voice: Calm, editorial, minimal, image-led. 3-word personality: Calm, Editorial, Minimal. Emotional goals: Inspire confidence, evoke creative ambition, convey refined taste and trustworthiness.

### Aesthetic Direction
Visual tone: Feels like a photography portfolio, campaign archive, and creative studio website. NOT a tech startup or AI product site. Dominant imagery, large typography, generous whitespace, subtle motion. Avoid cards, drop shadows, heavy UI, complex animations, SaaS-style layouts. Use Anton for logo, Georgia Italic for philosophy, DM Sans for interface. Restrained color palette (#F7F5F2, #111111, #555555). Light mode only. Editorial, quiet, and image-led.

### Design Principles
- Imagery is always the dominant element
- Interface remains quiet and minimal
- Large, editorial typography with clear hierarchy
- Generous whitespace and spacious layouts
- Subtle, purposeful motion only
- No cards, drop shadows, or SaaS conventions
- Portfolio must feel distinctive, not generic or "AI slop"
